## 业务分析

### 合作机会分析

#### 机会一：OEM供应合作（最高价值）
- Antaira是34人的精干团队，很可能外包制造
- Saga的工业级PoE交换机可作为Antaira的OEM供应
- Antaira的售价€500-700/台（8口），我们进货价仅¥100-200

#### 机会二：补充非管理型产品线
- Antaira以管理型工业交换机为主
- Saga的非管理型安防PoE交换机可补充其产品线
- 以Antaira品牌销售非管理型安防PoE

#### 机会三：价格竞争力合作
- Antaira产品价格高（€500-700/8口工业PoE）
- Saga可帮助Antaira推出"Value Line"经济型产品线

### 邮件切入点
```
Subject: Industrial PoE Switch OEM Partner | Expanding Antaira's Portfolio

Dear Carl,

As a fellow exhibitor at ISC West, I've been following Antaira's impressive 
industrial PoE switch portfolio with great interest.

I represent Saga Telecom — a manufacturer of industrial-grade PoE switches 
with ATEX, IP67, and wide-temperature capabilities. Given Antaira's lean team 
of ~34 professionals, we believe we could serve as a valuable OEM/ODM partner:

• Manufacturing your existing designs at competitive pricing
• Developing new "Value Line" products under the Antaira brand
• Expanding your non-managed PoE switch portfolio
• Providing CE/FCC/RoHS certified products with 2-year warranty

Our industrial PoE switches start at $15-25/unit (vs. your €500+ retail), 
providing significant margin opportunity.

Could we schedule a 15-minute call to explore possibilities?

Best regards,
```
